<translate>
<!--T:1-->
DragonMineZ adds its own items on top of vanilla Minecraft: healing beans, Dragon Ball radars, scouters, vehicles, stat capsules, relics and crafting materials. This page groups them by family; each row links the page that covers the item or the whole family in detail.

<!--T:2-->
Armor, special weapons, enchantments and training gear have their own pages, listed at the end.
</translate>

<translate>
== Dragon Ball tools == <!--T:3-->
</translate>
{{See also|Dragons and Wishes}}
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:4--> Page</translate> !! <translate><!--T:5--> Includes</translate> !! <translate><!--T:6--> What it does</translate>
|-
| {{L|Dragon Radar}} || <translate><!--T:7--> Dragon Radar (Earth), Dragon Radar (Namek), Bi-Dimensional Radar, Radar's Piece, Radar's Chips and Radar's CPUs</translate> || <translate><!--T:8--> Shows the Dragon Balls of its world on screen. The Bi-Dimensional Radar works on Earth and Namek. The chips and CPUs are also used in many other recipes.</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Transport == <!--T:9-->
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:10--> Page</translate> !! <translate><!--T:11--> Includes</translate> !! <translate><!--T:12--> What it does</translate>
|-
| {{L|Flying Nimbus}} || <translate><!--T:13--> Flying Nimbus, Black Nimbus</translate> || <translate><!--T:14--> A fast rideable cloud from Korin. Only the pure of heart can ride the Flying Nimbus; the Black Nimbus only carries evil hearts.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Space Pod}} || <translate><!--T:15--> Saiyan Space Pod</translate> || <translate><!--T:16--> A one-person spacecraft that takes you between worlds: Earth, Namek, the Otherworld, the Sacred Kai Planet, the Time Chamber and the Demon Realm.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Vehicles}} || <translate><!--T:92--> Red Car, Yellow Car, Capsule Corp. 576, Frieza's Capsule, Vehicle Engine, Vehicle Propeller, Vehicle Seat, Vehicle Plating</translate> || <translate><!--T:93--> Cars and an aircraft built from parts at a crafting table, and Frieza's Capsule from a Porunga wish. The page also covers the controls and rules every vehicle shares, the Space Pod and the clouds included.</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Scouters and stealth == <!--T:17-->
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:18--> Page</translate> !! <translate><!--T:19--> Includes</translate> !! <translate><!--T:20--> What it does</translate>
|-
| {{L|Scouters}} || <translate><!--T:21--> Scouter (Red), Scouter (Blue), Scouter (Green), Scouter (Purple)</translate> || <translate><!--T:22--> Read the Battle Power of the entity you look at and point to the strongest one nearby.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Anti-Ki Cloaking Device}} || — || <translate><!--T:23--> Hides your Battle Power from scouters, Ki Sense, Instant Transmission and party markers.</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Healing and consumables == <!--T:24-->
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:25--> Page</translate> !! <translate><!--T:26--> Includes</translate> !! <translate><!--T:27--> What it does</translate>
|-
| {{L|Senzu Bean}} || <translate><!--T:28--> Senzu Bean, Senzu Bean (Health), Senzu Bean (Ki), Senzu Bean (Stamina), Senzu Bean Seeds</translate> || <translate><!--T:29--> Fully restores health, ki and stamina. The colored beans restore only one resource each and can be farmed.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Senzu Bag}} || — || <translate><!--T:30--> Carries up to 64 Senzu Beans of any color in one slot and lets you eat them straight from the bag.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Heart Medicine}} || — || <translate><!--T:31--> Restores health, ki and stamina like a Senzu Bean. Brewed from a Senzu Bean.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Medi-Bugs}} || <translate><!--T:32--> Medi-Bug (Ant), Medi-Bug (Rhino), Medi-Bug (Worm), Pair of Medi-Bugs (Beetle)</translate> || <translate><!--T:33--> Demon Realm bugs that heal, harden your body, boost mastery gain or let two players fuse.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Fruit of the Tree of Might}} || — || <translate><!--T:34--> A temporary power boost (the Might Fruit effect).</translate>
|-
| {{L|Ki Battery}} || — || <translate><!--T:35--> Restores 50% of your max ki.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Food}} || <translate><!--T:36--> Dino Meat, Baby Dino Meat, Dino Tail, Frog Legs, Giant Fish, Giant Turtle</translate> || <translate><!--T:37--> DMZ's own foods. Eating any food also restores a share of your health, ki and stamina.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Golden Carrot}} || — || <translate><!--T:38--> The vanilla golden carrot, which DMZ asks for in quests and hands out as a raid reward.</translate>
|}

<translate>
<!--T:39-->
All Senzu Beans share one cooldown, so you can't chain one of each color. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Senzu Bean#Cooldown|Senzu Bean]].
</translate>

|-

|}

</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:49--> Page</translate> !! <translate><!--T:50--> What it does</translate>
|-

|-

</translate>

<translate>
== Other items == <!--T:79-->
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:80--> Item</translate> !! <translate><!--T:81--> What it does</translate>
|-
| '''<translate><!--T:82--> Blaster Cannon</translate>''' || <translate><!--T:83--> Fires a ki blast when you right-click it (3-second cooldown) and wears out after 200 shots. Rarely dropped by [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Soldier|Frieza Soldiers]] and given by the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]] raid.</translate>
|-
| '''<translate><!--T:84--> Music Discs</translate>''' || <translate><!--T:85--> 39 Dragon Ball soundtrack discs. |-
| '''<translate><!--T:86--> Treasure maps</translate>''' || <translate><!--T:87--> Sold by the [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Capsule Corp Namekian]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Namekian Traders]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Time Patroller|Time Patroller]]. They lead to DMZ structures and world boss lairs (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]]).</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Curios slots == <!--T:88-->

<!--T:89-->
Several DMZ items are worn in Curios slots instead of armor slots:

<!--T:90-->
* '''Head Tech''' slot: [[Special:MyLanguage/Scouters|scouters]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Anti-Ki Cloaking Device|Anti-Ki Cloaking Device]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Potara Earrings|Potara earrings]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Eye|Demon Eye]].
* '''Weights''' slot: the [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|weights]].

<!--T:91-->
Scouters, Potara earrings and weights also work in the cosmetic Curios slots.
</translate>
